items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: you know with people like Ernie Caceres, Jack Teagarden, Louis Armstrong, Jess Stacey — the names galore, as they’re all historical more or less now. And I had a chance to play with all of them

ctx.x: I mean was it as interesting as they say?

It was very interesting, and I’m having a second awakening with it because it’s so many years ago and it’s just so hard to remember so much of that. During that period we had done a whole gang of radio shows for the armed services with Eddie Condon. And a fellow by the name of Ernie Anderson was a marvelous promoter and a marvelous entrepreneur. And he had organized these things where we played for the armed services and we had weekly programs, you know with people like Ernie Caceres, Jack Teagarden, Louis…
well recorded, and it’s really a kick just to sit in there. I’ve spent hours just listening to them. I play with them a little bit, just to practice, to see what you were doing.
